template.description: Decompose a complex machine from whole-system structure into regions, functions, components, technical routes, BOM value, bottlenecks, import dependence, and localization evidence.

steps.title: Define whole-system structure
steps.purpose: Set the machine boundary, operating objective, and major physical regions.
quality_gates: The physical decomposition must cover the full system without overlapping regions.

steps.title: Map functional systems
steps.purpose: Map perception, compute, control, actuation, sensing, power, communication, and structural functions to physical regions.
quality_gates: Every major operating requirement must map to at least one functional system.

steps.title: Decompose core components
steps.purpose: Break each functional system into components, subsystems, materials, software, and integration layers.
quality_gates: Every non-root node must have a valid parent and supported node type.

steps.title: Compare technical routes
steps.purpose: Separate competing component and subsystem routes by performance, maturity, cost, reliability, and integration impact.
quality_gates: A preferred route requires evidence beyond company marketing material.

steps.title: Assess BOM and value capture
steps.purpose: Separate BOM share, ASP, margin, scarcity, certification, technology barrier, and integration control.
quality_gates: BOM share cannot be used as a substitute for margin or business materiality.

steps.title: Assess bottlenecks
steps.purpose: Identify performance, reliability, manufacturing, supply, software, and customer-verification constraints.
quality_gates: A high bottleneck score requires a measurable gap or remains needs_evidence.

steps.title: Assess import dependence and localization
steps.purpose: Compare overseas leaders, domestic capability, product qualification, scale production, and customer adoption.
quality_gates: Localization requires product-level capability and customer evidence, not company-name mentions.

steps.title: Prepare company mapping queue
steps.purpose: Prepare later company-to-node mapping with explicit role, revenue relevance, and evidence requirements.
quality_gates: Company mapping stays optional and blocked until node relationship and evidence are explicit.

node_archetypes.label: Whole System
node_archetypes.purpose: The complete machine and its operating objective.

node_archetypes.label: Physical Region
node_archetypes.purpose: A structural region such as head, torso, arm, hand, hip, knee, or ankle.

node_archetypes.label: Functional System
node_archetypes.purpose: A perception, compute, control, actuation, sensing, power, or communication function.

node_archetypes.label: Core Component
node_archetypes.purpose: A physical component or equipment unit delivering the function.

node_archetypes.label: Technical Route
node_archetypes.purpose: A competing implementation route for a component or subsystem.

node_archetypes.label: Control And Sensing Layer
node_archetypes.purpose: Cross-region sensing, control, compute, and communication components.

node_archetypes.label: Power And Material Layer
node_archetypes.purpose: Cross-system batteries, wiring, bearings, and structural materials.

source_requirements.use_case: reviewed BOM, bottleneck, or localization claim
